{{nihongo|'''Sakurama Shrine'''|桜間神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

It is known for the '''Sakurama Pond Site''', a Tokushima Prefecture designated historic site.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* {{ill|Konohanasakuya-hime|az|Konohanasakuya|ca|Konohana no Sakuya hime|de|Konohanasakuyahime|fa|کونوهاناساکویا-هیمه|fr|Konohana-no-Sakuya|it|Konohanasakuya-hime|ja|コノハナノサクヤビメ|ko|고노하나노사쿠야비메|mni|ꯀꯣꯅꯣꯍꯅꯁꯀꯨꯌ-ꯍꯤꯃꯦ|pl|Konohanasakuya-hime|ru|Коноханасакуя-химэ|sv|Konohanasakuyahime|th|เซ็นเง็ง|vi|Konohana Sakuya Hime|zh|木花開耶姬|qid=Q1781862|lt=Konohanasakuya-hime-no-Mikoto}}

=== History ===
The year of foundation is unknown. There is a pond in the precincts, and in the {{ill|Kamakura period|Q236205|qid=Q236205}} poetry collection ''Fuboku Wakashū'', Sakurama Pond is praised as "a pond as beautiful as a mirror." Later, however, sediment carried out from the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Yoshino River}} greatly reduced the size of the pond.

To preserve the beauty of Sakurama Pond for later generations, {{ill|Hachisuka Narimasa|eo|Haĉisuka Narimasa|fr|Hachisuka Narimasa|ja|蜂須賀斉昌|qid=Q304892}}, lord of the {{ill|Tokushima Domain|Q3034557|qid=Q3034557}}, ordered a stone monument to be erected in {{ill|1828|Q7570|qid=Q7570}} (Bunsei 11), mobilizing about 6,000 people to transport a giant rock of about 75 tons from the coast of Higashi-Yuki in {{ill|Kaifu District, Tokushima|Q1155923|qid=Q1155923|lt=Kaifu District}} (today's {{ill|Minami, Tokushima|Q1351153|qid=Q1351153}}). On {{ill|September 9|Q2856|qid=Q2856}}, {{ill|1969|Q2485|qid=Q2485}} (Shōwa 44), the "Sakurama Pond Site (stone monument)" was designated a Tokushima Prefecture historic site.

=== Access ===
* About 40 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kō Station (Tokushima)|Q6455068|qid=Q6455068|lt=Fuchu Station}} on the {{ill|Tokushima Line|Q899310|qid=Q899310}} of {{ill|Shikoku Railway Company|Q496531|qid=Q496531|lt=JR}}.
